[button aria-label] Open menu
How it works
No app to download, no self-checkout — a real person reviews and handles every step.
1. Tell us what you need
Fill out the quote form with what you're looking to rent, your address, and your preferred term. It takes about two minutes.
2. We follow up personally
Chris reviews every request himself and calls or texts you back — usually the same day — to confirm details and answer questions.
3. Sign your rental agreement
Once everything's confirmed, you'll sign a straightforward rental agreement electronically. Your price is locked in from that point on.
4. Delivery & installation
We schedule a delivery window that works for you, bring the appliance, install it, and haul away your old one if you need that.
5. Ongoing service
If anything ever needs attention, you contact us directly — not a national warranty line. We track every request until it's resolved.
